"""RoboPaint episode record. Commands use only public RGB/depth/proprio and kinematics."""
import os,sys,json,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot
ROOT='/app/runs'
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
Q=np.array([0.,1.,0.,0.])
ZP=.0202

def obs(name='obs', cameras=None,depth=False):
    v=r.get_obs(cameras=cameras or ['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],depth=depth)
    v.save(ROOT+'/'+name)
    return v

def run(P,name,dt=.05,cameras=None,fps=20):
    P=np.asarray(P);np.save(ROOT+'/'+name+'_actions.npy',P)
    before=r.status();open(ROOT+'/'+name+'_before.json','w').write(json.dumps(before))
    v=r.submit('ee_pose',P,dt=dt,cameras=cameras or ['practice_cam','canvas_cam'],video='frames',video_fps=fps,note=name)
    v.save(ROOT+'/'+name)
    print(name,'pose',v.group('tcp_pose',now=True),'steps',v.meta.get('control_steps'),'plan',v.meta.get('plan'),flush=True)
    return v

def pose(x,y,z): return [x,y,z,*Q]
def move(x,y,z,name,seconds=2):
    return run([pose(x,y,z)]*int(seconds/.1),name,dt=.1,fps=5)
def line(a,b,n):return np.linspace(a,b,n).tolist()

def ink(name='dip'):
    move(-.10,.185,.080,name+'_above')
    move(-.10,.185,.023,name+'_down',1.5)
    move(-.10,.185,.080,name+'_up',1)

if __name__=='__main__':
    exec(sys.argv[1])

        start=next(iter(adj));cur=start;prev=None;pts=[]
        while True:
            pts.append(points[cur]);ns=adj.pop(cur,None)
            if not ns:break
            nxt=ns[0] if ns[0]!=prev or len(ns)==1 else ns[1]
            prev,cur=cur,nxt
            if cur==start:break
        if len(pts)>10:loops.append(np.array(pts))
    return sorted(loops,key=len,reverse=True)

def path(stroke,spacing=.00045,inset=.00045,speed=.005):
    a=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/target.png'))[:,:,0]<100;l,n=nd.label(a);m=l==stroke
    # Subpixel signed distance to target boundary
    inside=nd.distance_transform_edt(m);outside=nd.distance_transform_edt(~m)
    sd=np.where(m,inside-.5,-outside+.5)
    sd=nd.gaussian_filter(sd,.8)
    v,u=np.unravel_index(np.argmax(sd),sd.shape);center=np.array([u+.5,v+.5])
    loops=[]
    for lev in np.arange(inset/SCALE,sd.max(),spacing/SCALE):
        cs=contours(sd,lev)
        for c in cs:
            # smooth stairs while retaining the target's larger edge variations
            c=nd.gaussian_filter1d(c,1.5,axis=0,mode='wrap')
            loops.append(c)
    seq=[center];pos=center
    for c in loops:
        j=np.argmin(np.sum((c-pos)**2,axis=1));c=np.roll(c,-j,axis=0)
        # clockwise traversal; no crossings outside nested boundaries
        for p in c:seq.append(p)
        seq.append(c[0]);pos=c[0]
    seq.append(center)
    pts=np.array(seq);ds=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(pts,axis=0),axis=1)*SCALE
    keep=np.r_[True,ds>1e-8];pts=pts[keep]
    t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(pts,axis=0),axis=1)*SCALE)]
    outt=np.arange(0,t[-1],speed*.05)
    uv=np.c_[np.interp(outt,t,pts[:,0]),np.interp(outt,t,pts[:,1])]
    uv=np.vstack([uv,pts[-1]])
    return uv, {'length_m':float(t[-1]),'loops':len(loops),'start_uv':center.tolist(),'steps':len(uv)}

def world(uv,xshift=0,yshift=0,depth=.0015):
    from gen import Q,ZP
    uv=np.asarray(uv)
    return np.c_[.0135925-uv[:,1]*SCALE+xshift,.1135925-uv[:,0]*SCALE+yshift,np.full(len(uv),ZP-depth),np.tile(Q,(len(uv),1))]

    for i in [1,2]:
        uv,meta=path(i);np.save('/app/output/fill%d_uv.npy'%i,uv);print(i,meta)
